item.title: Phosphonium outperforms ammonium poly(ionic liquids) for fast ion transport polymer electrolytes

Authors: Kewei Cai, Jhonatan Soto Puelles, Alejandro Herranz Berzosa, Gabriele Lingua, David Mecerreyes, Daniel Brandell, Maria Forsyth, Fangfang Chen

Poly(ionic liquid) electrolytes with phosphonium cations exhibit weaker interionic interactions, enhanced Li + and Na + transport, and distinct interfacial chemistry near highly negatively charged metal surfaces compared with their ammonium analogues.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06154k
